text: SEC rules should be amended to require public companies, particularly financial institutions, to disclose their material exposure to hedge funds and other highly leveraged institutions in the MD&A or Description of Business sections, which would be consistent with existing SEC disclosure philosophy.
citation: Kaal and Oesterle, The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2714974

isBasedOn.name: The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States

abstract: SEC rules could provide for such disclosures in the Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) or Description of Business segments of the periodic financial statements.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to publicly traded lenders and counterparties of hedge funds
